༄༅/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /༈/bdag bskyed ni/mchog gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid bla ma la/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dpal phyag na rdo rje 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs bsdus pa bzhugs so// ༈ /bdag bskyed ni/ mchog gsum 'dus pa'i bdag nyid bla ma la// sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas skyabs su mchi// mtha' yas ma gyur 'gro kun srid mtsho las// sgrol ba'i bla med byang chub sems bskyed do// tshar gsum/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig dran rdzogs su// bdag nyid hūm̐ las dpal chen gsang ba'i bdag /mthing nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i rtsa phyag gnyis// thugs kar 'byung po kun 'dul phyag rgya mdzad// g.yas g.yon lhag mas rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin// pad nyi bgegs kyi steng na brkyang bskums bzhugs// hūm̐ badz+ra phaṭa ci 'grub bzla/ dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo smon bya'o// gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa'o/// / ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
